description: §47.1.1 (S439 #7 + S440 #9, security) — a server function calls the compiler's raw database handle `_scrml_sql` directly. Before the check this compiled clean and ran the query with no `?{}`-lowering floor (no §14.8.10 tenant filter, no §14.8.9 protect tagging, no transaction gate). A reference to a `_scrml_`-prefixed name is a compile error. (-pos: the code fires.)
rationale: §47.1.1 S440 ruling (#9): a user-authored scrml program SHALL NOT reference a name that begins with `_scrml_` — the reservation covers references as well as declarations, under E-NAME-COLLIDES-RESERVED-PREFIX. The `_scrml_` prefix names compiler/runtime identifiers.
